title: Tighten the README's acceptance-policy and Execution Observability wording
outcome: Tighten the README's acceptance-policy and Execution Observability wording
acceptance: The README's --require-source-freshness bullet no longer reads as requiring a declaration at done for a live registered check; it defers to the paragraph on when done needs one
The evaluate lead-in limits the mandatory declaration to live registered input on the run or registered evidence the evaluation relies on, not any run with registered checks
The sentence after the TermAl setting names Execution Observability as its subject, so 'never admits, delays or refuses a model turn' is not read as the setting
The Execution Observability overview says in one sentence that done and show can report untested source changes and that open required checks can block completion
The mixed-build limit is scoped to rolling out live registered-input decisions, keeping the readiness limitation
The Git limits also say that edits reverted between measurements can go unseen
